title: Inner and outer isometries of graphs of polynomials
summary: We classify graphs of complex polynomials in one variable up to isometry, both for the inner (length) distance and for the outer (Euclidean) distance of $\mathbb{C}^2\cong\mathbb{R}^4$. For polynomials $p,q$ with $°p\ge 2$ we show that the graphs of $p$ and $q$ are inner isometric if and only if they are outer isometric, if and only if $p(z)=α\,q(βz+h)+k$ or $p(z)=α\,\bar q(βz+h)+k$ for some $α,β,h,k\in\mathbb{C}$ with $|α|=|β|=1$, where $\bar q$ denotes the polynomial with conjugate coefficients.
